title_for_Word: England and Wales coronial activity over time
caption: Official national counts, 1995 to 2025. Registered deaths include non-residents. The 2024 revised and 2025 provisional year flags specifically qualify registered-death denominators in this edition. Reporting-system and medical-examiner changes affect interpretation; no causal effect is estimated. Earlier benchmark years are retained in the table, not joined.

title_for_Word: Duration measures in three coronial settings
caption: Separate clocks and populations: NZ closed-case mean in days; Victoria closed death/fire investigation mean in days with start not specified on inspected source page; England and Wales domestic-occurring inquest time in weeks from reporting to conclusion/nonresumption. The latter is estimated from bands, including an 18-month assignment for over-12-month cases; published rounded values are shown. No conversion, pooling or ranking is justified.
